notes.title: Hotfix Implemented for Enhanced Controller Sensitivity
notes.content:
Crucial hotfix in our latest game update. This update introduces a new feature for controller users: the ability to adjust the minimum sensitivity threshold of the controller sticks.

This enhancement was developed in response to feedback from our player community who experienced issues with unintended camera drift and character movement. With the new "Controller Threshold Stick" setting, players can now fine-tune the sensitivity of their controllers, ensuring a more precise and tailored gaming experience.

We appreciate your continued support and feedback, which are vital in helping us improve the game. Happy gaming!
